notes.subject: ol man i dai pinis
notes.rationale: מתים 'the dead': dead idols (lifeless gods) vs sacrifices to/for the dead vs sacrifices of animals that die; rendered literally 'ol man i dai pinis'

notes.subject: holim pas
notes.rationale: ויצמדו literally 'yoke/link themselves', rendered as binding attachment in Tok Pisin

translation: Na ol i bin holim pas long Baal-Peor, na ol i kaikaiim ol ofa bilong ol man i dai pinis.

tokens.gloss: Na ol i bin holim pas
bilong ol man i dai pinis
